name: Lord Bolas
description: An elder dragon planeswalker (character) who threatens to punish with the ground itself and whose disciple speaks of him.

description_citations.text: Commander 2014: card flavor text (Commander 2014, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas threatens to punish his foes with the very ground they flee on.
timeline.quote: Where will you run when I punish you with the very ground you flee on?
